entries.title: US-only PHI offshore access restriction
entries.summary: AtliQ Inc, its Affiliates, and Subcontractors are prohibited from accessing, storing, processing, transmitting, or viewing PHI or Limited Data Sets from any location outside the United States.
entries.quote: Business Associate shall not, and shall ensure that its Subcontractors and Affiliates do not, access, store, process, transmit or view PHI — including any Limited Data Set — from any location outside the United States, whether directly or through remote access, virtual desktop or screen-sharing.

relatedClauses.quote: Affiliates of Business Associate are Subcontractors for this purpose.

Data that has been de-identified in accordance with the Safe Harbor method at 45 C.F.R. §164.514(b)(2) may be accessed outside the United States only with Covered Entity's prior written approval for each data set.

entries.endRule: Coterminous with Services Agreement (ends 24 August 2027) or for as long as PHI is retained
entries.notes: Extends to AtliQ Inc's Affiliates, including AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd (India).

entries.title: 5-day breach and incident notification window
entries.summary: AtliQ Inc must report any unpermitted PHI use or disclosure, Security Incident, or Breach of Unsecured PHI to Ashwood Senior Living within 5 business days of discovery.
entries.quote: Business Associate shall report to Covered Entity any use or disclosure of PHI not permitted by this BAA, any Security Incident, and any Breach of Unsecured PHI without unreasonable delay and in any event within five (5) business days of discovery.
entries.endRule: Coterminous with Services Agreement (ends 24 August 2027) or for as long as PHI is retained

entries.title: Cyber liability insurance ($3M)
entries.summary: AtliQ Inc must maintain cyber liability insurance with limits of at least USD 3,000,000 per claim, naming Ashwood Senior Living as an additional insured.
entries.quote: Business Associate shall maintain cyber liability insurance with limits of not less than USD 3,000,000 per claim, naming Covered Entity as additional insured, and provide a certificate on request.

entries.title: PHI de-identification and data use restriction
entries.summary: AtliQ Inc may not de-identify PHI except as necessary to perform services under the Services Agreement, and is prohibited from using de-identified data for its own purposes or for other clients.
entries.quote: Business Associate shall not de-identify PHI for any purpose other than performing the services, and shall not use de-identified data for its own purposes or for other clients.
entries.endRule: Coterminous with Services Agreement (ends 24 August 2027) or for as long as PHI is retained

entries.title: Prior written approval for PHI subcontractors and affiliates
entries.summary: AtliQ Inc must obtain Ashwood Senior Living's prior written approval before engaging any subcontractor or Affiliate that creates, receives, maintains, or transmits PHI.
entries.quote: Business Associate shall not engage any Subcontractor that creates, receives, maintains or transmits PHI without Covered Entity's prior written approval.

relatedClauses.quote: Affiliates of Business Associate are Subcontractors for this purpose.

entries.endRule: Coterminous with Services Agreement (ends 24 August 2027) or for as long as PHI is retained
entries.notes: Expressly categorizes AtliQ Inc's Affiliates (such as AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd) as Subcontractors requiring approval.
